requiredRuntimeProof: native road terrain or road flag read proof
native neutral data source proof when preview displays neutral intention
existing map object runtime identity proof
fog reveal mutation ordering proof where reveal is used

requiredRuntimeSemantics: The predicate must read native road terrain, road tile, or equivalent road flag state for the current Castle hero position.
Road state, hero coordinates, reveal side, fog mutation target, and active Castle law owner must correlate before conditional view-radius expansion.
The law must not replace road-conditioned vision with always-on view radius or generic movement/terrain bonuses.
forbiddenSubstitutes: always-on view radius counted as road terrain
generic movement points counted as road terrain
biome or terrain category counted as road without road flag proof
road-looking map art counted as road terrain
pathfinding cost alone counted as road terrain
Castle faction membership counted as road terrain
fog reveal mutation counted without current hero road proof

requiredRuntimeSemantics: The predicate must remain a read-only tooltip or preview boundary for Dungeon neutral intention data.
Preview output must be backed by native neutral threat or intention data and must not mutate fog, rewards, diplomacy, combat, resources, or neutral stack state.
Hero proximity, target neutral stack identity, preview receiver, and active Dungeon law owner must correlate before showing the tooltip preview.
forbiddenSubstitutes: tooltip text parsed as native neutral data
read-only tooltip preview counted as gameplay mutation
fog reveal mutation counted as tooltip preview
reward or diplomacy mutation counted as tooltip preview
object category allowlist counted as neutral intention data
Dungeon faction membership counted as tooltip preview permission
preview shown without neutral stack identity proof

requiredRuntimeSemantics: The predicate must classify existing runtime map objects that match the Hellgate Omens object allowlist or exact object-class taxonomy.
Existing object identity, object coordinates, reveal side, object allowlist, fog mutation target, and active Inferno law owner must correlate before reveal.
The law may reveal existing pocket-dimension, teleporter, Inferno-dwelling, or summoning-site objects, but must not create teleport, ocean travel, gate, or summoning mechanics.
forbiddenSubstitutes: fabricated teleport mechanic counted as existing map object class
fabricated ocean travel mechanic counted as existing map object class
created object counted as existing map object without runtime object identity
object icon or art counted as object class
localized display text counted as object class
Inferno faction membership counted as object class
generic object category counted without exact allowlist proof
